visual.general_description: Grayscale coronal contrast-enhanced CT slice of the torso (abdomen and lower chest) on a black background, cropped at the sides. A small orientation letter 'S' is at the top and 'R' at the left; a scale ruler with tick marks runs along the bottom.
visual.detailed_description: Coronal reformatted CT with enhancing soft tissue and vessels. The upper left shows the homogeneous liver, with ribs along both sides and a bright rounded structure at the top center (lower chest/heart region); a gas-containing stomach-like structure with mottled content lies at upper right. Numerous gas-filled and fluid-filled bowel loops fill the central and lower abdomen, several with thickened, layered walls and brighter wall enhancement, mainly in the lower abdomen. A red dotted line with a small gray measurement label lies across a bowel loop in the lower left of the abdomen (image left of midline); the label text is too small to read reliably. A rounded fluid-density structure is at the bottom center, and a very bright linear structure is at lower right. No name, date or identification text is visible; only the 'R' and 'S' orientation letters and the ruler.

pixel_observations: Coronal grayscale CT slice with orientation letters "R" at the left edge and "S" at the top.
Multiple gas-filled and fluid-filled bowel loops, several with thickened enhancing walls, in the central and lower abdomen.
A red dotted measurement line with a small gray label over a bowel loop in the lower left of the image; the label value is not legible.
A scale ruler with tick marks along the bottom edge; no patient name, date or identifier text visible.

caption_claims.value: Caption states contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen and pelvis, coronal view, with bowel wall thickening and mural enhancement most prominently in the rectum and a 6 cm segment of the terminal ileum. Rectum is not clearly identifiable in this slice and the 6 cm length is not measured from the pixels.

limitations: The measurement label beside the red dotted line is too small to read; no value is recorded.
Bowel wall thickening, the rectum and the 6 cm ileal segment cannot be independently confirmed or measured from this single slice; they are caption claims.
The bright linear structure at lower right and the rounded structure at the bottom center are not identified by the caption.
